meta.definition: First visit after the zone became knowable; resting order at the proximal edge, stop a quarter height beyond the distal edge. full: one unit, -1R stop, +T R target. scale: half at the edge, other half added at the first close at or beyond +1R with the stop moved to entry. Time-outs marked at the final close. PF = gross R won / gross R lost. win_k = share of resolved visits (target or stop) that reached k R first. Control: the same band 1.5 heights away from the base.
meta.caveat: Replay history, not a track record. Parameters tuned on nine zones Ben drew on 30 Oct 2026 (in-sample); the rest shares the parameters, not the charts. No costs, no slippage, fills assumed at the edge.
